headline: Some PCs are assembled. This one was interrogated.
story: We didn't just build Prometheus — we benchmarked it, tuned it, and benchmarked it again, until every number told the same story. This is a Ryzen 7 7800X3D and RTX 3070 build that scores higher than 92 out of every 100 systems ever tested on Novabench's own global platform. Not a marketing number — a measured one.
feelStory: Load into Valorant and watch 587fps go by without a stutter. Drop into Cyberpunk 2077 and get a locked, smooth frame rate at Ultra. Then close the game, open Premiere Pro, and cut 4K footage without waiting on a spinning wheel. Prometheus isn't a machine that does one thing well — it's one that stops noticing what you throw at it.
gamesFootnote: Full 7-game breakdown (Warzone, Baldur's Gate 3, Elden Ring, RDR2) in the linked performance report.
